about: Google Stitch prompts for the new Work case studies and Insights articles. Each prompt is self-contained (the visual style is written into it), so you can paste it as-is.
howToUse: Create one Stitch project per item and choose the device shown in `device` (Web or Mobile).
Paste `cover.prompt` first. For gallery screens, stay in the same Stitch project and paste each gallery prompt as a follow-up, so the style stays consistent.
Export each screen as PNG (2x if offered) and send it to me with the `id` in the file name. Any size is fine: I'll crop to `size`, compress to JPG, save it as `file` and swap it in through the admin.
Covers are required. Gallery screens are optional: use 1 or 3 per case study, because 2 leaves a gap in the page layout.
CLEAR is a phone app: export the three phone screens separately and I'll compose them side by side on the brand background.
